select a.*, b.CX_CLASS1_PLAN,b.CX_CLASS2_PLAN,b.CX_CLASS3_PLAN,b.CX_CLASS4_PLAN,b.CX_CLASS5_PLAN from ( select max(cxr.SCHEDULE_DATE) SCHEDULE_DATE, /*排程日期*/ max(cxr.BATCH_NO) TQ_BATCH_NO, /*胎圈批次号*/ ci.BEAD_CODE STEEL_RING_CODE, /*钢丝圈代码*/ max(ci.BEAD_TYPE) STEEL_TYPE, /*钢丝类型*/ max(ci.BEAD_ARRANGE) `RANK`, /*排列*/ max(ci.DIMENSION) DIMENSION, /*寸口*/ 1 unit_consume, /*对应成型单耗*/ IFNULL(sum(txr.NIGHT_PLAN_QTY),0) LAST_MID_TQ_PLAN_QTY, /* 胎圈前日早班计划量 */ IFNULL(sum(cxr.MID_PLAN_QTY),0) LAST_NIGHT_TQ_PLAN_QTY, /* 胎圈前日夜班计划量 */ IFNULL(sum(cxr.NIGHT_PLAN_QTY),0) MID_PLAN_QTY, /* 夜班计划量=胎圈早班计划量 */ IFNULL(sum(cxr.DAY_PLAN_QTY),0) NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, /* 早班计划量 = 胎圈次日夜班计划量 */ max(cxr.CLOSE_OUT_SPEC_FLAG) CLOSE_OUT_SPEC_FLAG, 0 DAY_PLAN_QTY from T_TQ_SCHEDULE_RESULT cxr /*胎圈排程结果表*/ inner join (SELECT TIRE_RING_CODE, MAX(BEAD_CODE) BEAD_CODE, MAX(BEAD_ARRANGE) BEAD_ARRANGE, MAX(BEAD_TYPE) BEAD_TYPE, max(Dimension) DIMENSION FROM T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO WHERE DEL_FLAG = 0
and PRODUCTION_STAGE = '0'
GROUP BY TIRE_RING_CODE) ci on cxr.BEAD_CODE = ci.TIRE_RING_CODE /*施工信息表*/ left join ( SELECT BEAD_CODE, IFNULL(sum(NIGHT_PLAN_QTY),0) NIGHT_PLAN_QTY FROM T_TQ_SCHEDULE_RESULT WHERE schedule_date = DATE_ADD(#{scheduleDate}, INTERVAL -1 day) /*上一天的胎圈计划*/ AND DEL_FLAG = 0 GROUP BY BEAD_CODE ) txr ON txr.BEAD_CODE = cxr.BEAD_CODE where schedule_date = STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') and cxr.DEL_FLAG = 0 group by ci.BEAD_CODE) a left join ( select BEAD_CODE, IFNULL(sum(cxr.CLASS1_PLAN_QTY*1),0) CX_CLASS1_PLAN, /*对应成型一班的钢丝圈胶计划量=成型计划量*1 */ IFNULL(sum(cxr.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY*1),0) CX_CLASS2_PLAN, /*对应成型二班的钢丝圈胶计划量*/ IFNULL(sum(cxr.CLASS3_PLAN_QTY*1),0) CX_CLASS3_PLAN, /*对应成型三班的钢丝圈胶计划量*/ IFNULL(sum(cxr.CLASS4_PLAN_QTY*1),0) CX_CLASS4_PLAN, /*对应成型次一班的钢丝圈胶计划量*/ IFNULL(sum(cxr.CLASS5_PLAN_QTY*1),0) CX_CLASS5_PLAN /*对应成型次二班的钢丝圈胶计划量*/ from T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT cxr /*成型排程结果表*/ inner join T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci on cxr.EMBRYO_CODE = ci.embryo_code and cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION = ci.EMBRYO_VERSION /*施工信息表*/ where schedule_date = STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
and ci.PRODUCTION_STAGE = '0'
and cxr.DEL_FLAG = 0 and ci.DEL_FLAG = 0 group by ci.BEAD_CODE ) b on a.STEEL_RING_CODE = b.BEAD_CODE WHERE LAST_MID_TQ_PLAN_QTY > 0 OR LAST_NIGHT_TQ_PLAN_QTY > 0 OR MID_PLAN_QTY > 0 OR NIGHT_PLAN_QTY > 0

select ci.BEAD_CODE STEEL_RING_CODE, /*钢丝圈代码*/ GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT concat(cxr.CX_MACHINE_CODE,'$',cxr.EMBRYO_CODE,'$',cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION) order by cxr.CX_MACHINE_CODE,cxr.EMBRYO_CODE,cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION SEPARATOR ',') as quotaKeys /*机台code$胎胚代码*/ from T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT cxr /*成型排程结果表*/ inner join T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci on cxr.EMBRYO_CODE = ci.embryo_code and cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION = ci.EMBRYO_VERSION /*施工信息表*/ where schedule_date = STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') and cxr.DEL_FLAG = 0 and ci.DEL_FLAG = 0
and ci.PRODUCTION_STAGE = '0'
group by ci.BEAD_CODE
